Secy. ... on 5 June, 2025

Author: Jaspreet Singh

High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Neutral Citation No. - 2025:Ahc-Lko:34661
Court No. - 4
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 4786 of 2025
Applicant :- Amrapali Gautam And Another
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy. Deptt. Home Lko.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
And Another Counsel for Applicant :- Deepak Kumar Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Jaspreet Singh,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for applicants and learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the material available on record.

2. By means of the present application under Section 528 of the Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita,
2023 (482 Cr.P.C.) the applicants have sought prayer to quash the proceedings arising out of Case No.1848 of 2024 (State v. Amarpali Gautam & Anr) in Case Crime No.0244 of 2023 U/s 419, 420 &
406 I.P.C., Police Station- Inayat Nagar, District Ayodhya pending before the Learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate 3rd Ayodhya and also quash the cyclostyle summoning order dated 02.02.2024 as well as BW order dated 14.05.2025 passed by learned Additional Chief Judicial Amrapali Gautam And Another vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy. ... on 5 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/198071541/

1 Magistrate 3rd Ayodhya in the interest of justice.
3. Learned counsel for applicants, after arguing at some length submits that grievance of the applicants shall be redressed in case liberty is granted to the applicants to file a bail application which may be decided in view of law laid down by Supreme Court in "Satender Kumar Antil versus Central Bureau of Investigation and another, Special Leave to Appeal (Cri)No.5191 of 2021" to which learned A.G.A. has no objection.

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil versus Central Bureau of Investigation and another, Special Leave to Appeal (Cri)No.5191 of 2021
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. In view of the above, prayer for quashing the impugned proceeding is refused.

So far as other prayer is concerned, it is provided that in case the applicants appear before the trial court within three weeks from today and apply for bail, the same shall be decided expeditiously, in view of the law laid down by Supreme Court in Satender Kumar Antil's case (supra).
5.
The application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is disposed of accordingly.
